description: 5×5 catalogue of Chladni modes, m down and n across, each plate settled by chladni/basic's particle walk onto its nodal lines
notable: The m = n diagonal plates come out as plain grids; the matrix is symmetric across it

description: One closed curve grown by differential growth inside a polyomino domain, drawn as a single constant-width band
notable: Reuses terminal-ui/growth-sim unchanged; nodes that cross the domain edge are projected back inside

description: Meshing gear train whose axle pulleys carry one serpentine belt drawn as haberdashery's bevelled band
notable: Pulleys at 0.46 of each gear keep one belt speed across the train; every gear turns a whole number of teeth per loop so it closes seamlessly

description: Each pixel-font letter A–Z left as a hole in a square plate packed with circles, one plate per second
notable: Overlap with the letter is tested exactly against its pixel squares

description: Sidewinder maze extruded in heerich voxels, its BFS distance bands stepped down as stepwell terraces with the solved path sunk
notable: Walls stand one voxel above their higher neighbour, so each distance band reads as a terrace

description: Two Warnsdorff Hamiltonian paths on an A4 sheet as two plotter pens, a broad ghost marker under a fine ink liner
notable: Each pen is one unbroken polyline; the SVG export holds one Inkscape layer per pen

description: nalee walkers fill a bipolar (τ, σ) grid round two foci as smooth solid bands whose gaps open toward the foci
notable: Band width comes from the exact bipolar scale factor at every sample; concentric rings fill each focus; plotter SVG export

description: Plotter fork of bipolar: a fixed gap in mm everywhere, on a quadtree grid that coarsens toward the foci so paths reach them
notable: Cells split only while every child stays at least gap + 1.5 pens wide; each grid level is walked by its own nalee system

description: nalee pipe walkers spelled in double-line box-drawing glyphs in the tui glyph buffer, a run of ink travelling each pipe
notable: Every straight move is a ═ or ║ rule and every turn a corner glyph; ║ shows hairline seams where Menlo's glyph height misses the line pitch

description: A million slime-mould agents as WebGPU compute, seeded on packed circle rims, trail drawn through a three-stop palette ramp
notable: exportFrame reads a WebGPU canvas only in the step that drew it, so exports draw a frame first

description: 16k physarum agents seen only through tui windows: a field overview, scopes locked on junctions, and a readout chart
notable: Scopes re-aim at the nearest junction as the network rewires and show every agent as a heading arrow
